Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa's Client Platforms and Enterprise Tools team owns the platforms that govern how clients and partners securely connect to Visa's APIs. As Sr. Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Visa Developer Platform's API Gateways, the encryption and key management capabilities that protect data in transit, and Visa's India data localization operations. Direct product strategy from product conception and definition through implementation. Identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Key Responsibilities

* **Own product strategy and the long-term roadmap for the Inbound API Gateway and its associated developer portal onboarding flows**
* **Define the roadmap for authentication and encryption mechanisms supported at the gateway (mTLS, PQC, OAuth, JWT/JWK) and prioritize new auth capabilities against client and regulatory demand**
* Own security configuration capabilities such as header whitelisting, and prioritize enhancements based on emerging threat models and client requirements
* Run front-door intake meetings and prioritize incoming feature, security, and integration requests from internal product teams and partners
* Manage the regional deployment roadmap, ensuring gateway capabilities and security configurations are rolled out consistently across regions
* Partner with security, cryptography, and platform engineering teams to validate that new authentication and encryption capabilities meet Visa's security and compliance bar
* Define and track performance key results (latency, availability, onboarding time, auth failure rates) to ensure ongoing product readiness
* Own documentation and enablement materials so internal teams and partners can self-serve gateway onboarding and configuration
* Monitor support/incident trends related to authentication and security configuration, feeding recurring issues back into the roadmap
* Present roadmap, KPIs, and key security/compliance decisions to leadership and governance forums on a recurring cadence
* Support daily operational needs requiring data access and retrieval by India-localized personnel, ensuring timely turnaround for internal and client requests
* Help ensure India-localized platforms and tools run reliably as a cohesive product suite, coordinating fixes and improvements across the underlying systems

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* + 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or 7 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD
* + **Proven experience as a Product Manager owning API platforms, gateways, or security/authentication infrastructure**
  + **Working knowledge of API authentication and security standards (OAuth, mTLS, JWT/JWK) and emerging areas such as post-quantum cryptography**
  + **Familiarity with encryption concepts (message-level and field-level encryption) and key management lifecycle practices**
  + Experience running intake/prioritization processes and setting product roadmaps for multiple concurrent workstreams
  + Experience partnering closely with security and cryptography engineering teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive capabilities
  + Understanding of data localization or data residency regulatory requirements is a plus
  + Strong stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, security, and compliance partners
  + Comfortable working with agile frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between our Product Strategy leaders and our Engineering teams. * **Key Responsibilities**
  + Execution & Backlog Management: Partner with our Vertical Product Strategy leaders to ingest their product requirements and translate them into deeply detailed, actionable development plans, Epics, and sprint backlogs for engineering.

jobs.description:
Product Manager, AI Products

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Experience:**
At least 2 years as a Product Manager; ideally 2–5 years of PM experience

About Tario

Tario is building AI-powered software that helps revenue teams identify opportunities, engage prospects, understand sales activity, and move work forward. Our product spans prospecting, engagement, reporting, CRM, and workflow automation.

We are a fast-moving team working to make AI useful in real business workflows. That means understanding where teams spend time, choosing the problems that matter most, and building experiences that work reliably alongside the systems customers already use.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager who can own customer-facing AI features from problem definition through launch and improvement. You’ll shape the user experience, set priorities, work closely with design and engineering, and use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve next.

This is a hands-on product role. You should be comfortable getting into the details of a workflow, testing an AI experience, and helping developers resolve ambiguity—while keeping the customer problem and product outcome at the center of your decisions.

Key Responsibilities

* Own product features from initial problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration
* Turn complex sales and business workflows into simple, useful product experiences
* Work with customers and internal teams to identify problems worth solving and test proposed solutions
* Define clear user flows, priorities, requirements, edge cases, and success measures
* Partner closely with designers and engineers to make trade-offs and deliver high-quality features
* Prototype ideas and test AI-powered workflows to learn quickly
* Evaluate where AI can complete useful work, where it needs human review, and how to handle failures
* Use product usage, customer feedback, and pilot results to improve or change direction
* Bring focus and clarity when there are many possible features to build

Required Qualifications

* At least
  **2 years of direct Product Manager experience**
  , with ownership of customer-facing features
* Experience building or managing a
  **B2B SaaS product**
* Evidence of taking a feature from customer or business problem to shipped result
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered products or substantial AI prototypes, and the ability to explain what worked and what did not
* Strong product judgment: you can simplify a workflow, prioritize what matters, and make decisions from evidence
* Ability to work closely with engineering on feasibility, edge cases, testing, and delivery without needing to own the technical architecture
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Based in Bengaluru or willing to work from Bengaluru

Preferred Qualifications

* An engineering background or strong technical foundation
* A strong academic foundation, including from a leading engineering college in India
* Experience with CRM, sales technology, workflow automation, enterprise SaaS, or integrations
* Experience building AI features that take action within a workflow, rather than only generating content

What We’re Looking For

You are curious, decisive, and motivated to ship. You ask what problem a feature solves and how we will know whether it worked. You can challenge assumptions, make a practical first version, and improve it quickly based on what customers actually do. You work well with developers and care just as much about the experience customers have as the technology behind it.

Why Join Tario

* Shape important product decisions at an early stage
* Work on AI-powered features used in real sales and business workflows
* Own meaningful work from idea through customer impact
* Work closely with a team that values speed, clear thinking, and learning from what ships

**Locatoin: Pune/Bangalore**

EdgeVerve Systems Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of Infosys) builds AI-, automation-, and analytics-led digital platforms that help enterprises transform operations at scale, with security and scalability at the core

**About AI Next**

EdgeVerve AI Next is a unified platform designed to scale Applied AI across the enterprise, built from the ground up to leverage Generative AI and bridge silos across people, processes, data, and technology to drive transformation in business operations.

AI Next also includes platform capabilities that support flexible model choices and enterprise-ready foundations for secure, scalable deployments.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a strategic and technically savvy Product Manager to lead AI‑First initiatives within our AI Next Platform team. This role focuses on creating scalable, high-impact AI solutions by partnering closely with data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders to productize cutting-edge machine learning models and AI capabilities.

As the champion of AI‑first thinking, you will help define and drive the roadmap for AI‑powered features, platform services, infrastructure, and tools that power intelligent applications across the organization and/or for external customers.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for AI‑first capabilities and features across the applied AI platform.
* Translate AI research, prototypes, and experimentation into production-ready products by working closely with research, data science, MLOps, and engineering teams.
* Define requirements for AI services, APIs, platform components, and infrastructure needed to support enterprise-scale AI use cases.
* Collaborate with UX, engineering, and stakeholders to prioritize AI use cases that deliver measurable business value and outcomes.
* Establish clear KPIs/OKRs to measure impact and performance of AI-driven features; continuously optimize using data and insights.
* Evangelize an“AI‑First” mindset across product and business units—help teams adopt AI as a native capability in their products.

* Drive experimentation and model validation pipelines, ensuring deployed models meet expectations on reliability, fairness, and explainability.
* Partner with Responsible AI / compliance stakeholders to ensure AI initiatives align with ethical, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Create strong product artifacts (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria), communicate trade-offs, and ensure crisp alignment across cross-functional teams (UX/Eng/Data Science/GTB/Support).
* Support go-to-market readiness by enabling internal stakeholders with positioning, value narratives, and adoption plans (as applicable to the platform/module owned).

**Required Skills**

**Product Management & Execution**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Product Management / Product Owner roles (B2B/enterprise product experience preferred).
* Strong ability to define problems, identify user/value drivers, write product requirements, and drive prioritization using data and business impact.

**Technical & AI/Platform Understanding**

* Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts (e.g., model lifecycle, evaluation metrics, inference vs. training, drift/monitoring).
* Exposure to APIs, platform products, and enterprise SaaS concepts (multi-tenant considerations, reliability, security, scalability).
* High comfort collaboration with engineering and data science teams; ability to translate between technical and business contexts.

**Stakeholder & Communication**

* Strong stakeholder management & ability to align diverse groups and drive decisions amid ambiguity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, structured thinking, and storytelling for leadership and cross-functional teams.

**Responsible AI & Governance Mindset**

* Awareness of privacy, security, and Responsible AI considerations (bias, explainability, guardrails, human-in-the-loop patterns).

**Education / Experience**

* MBA from a good-tier institute.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Computer Science / related field
* 5+ years of relevant Product Management/Product Ownership experience.
* Experience in one of the following preferred - Business Process orchestration, Agentic AI solutions, Data orchestration, Transformation and Operational transformation

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Seller Payments
jobs.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
eBay is looking for an experienced, highly driven product leader to own the growth of eBay Balance - our stored-value, wallet product.
  
  
In this role, you will define how eBay Balance serves customers across non-U.S. North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with an initial focus on markets such as Canada, Australia, and selected European countries. You will build experiences that enable customers to receive funds, hold value, reload their balance, and spend that value back on eBay.
  
  
This is not a localization or feature-maintenance role. It is an end-to-end product ownership opportunity: identifying the highest-potential customer use cases, shaping the international strategy, launching new capabilities, and creating the adoption flywheel that makes eBay Balance an everyday part of how customers engage with eBay.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of payments, commerce, and financial services - operating at the scale and complexity of one of the world’s largest global marketplaces.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Own the international product strategy and roadmap for eBay Balance across Canada, Australia, Europe, and additional non-U.S. markets.
* Identify the most valuable regional customer problems and determine where eBay Balance can create differentiated value for buyers and sellers.
* Design and improve the complete stored-value lifecycle, including how customers:

+ Receive or earn funds
+ Add or reload money
+ Hold and manage their balance
+ Spend funds back on the eBay platform

* Develop new product features, incentives, and customer experiences that increase activation, adoption, repeat usage, and spend.
* Build a market expansion framework that balances customer demand, business opportunity, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, and platform scalability.
* Lead products from discovery through launch and optimization, bringing structure and momentum to complex, ambiguous initiatives.
* Use customer research, behavioral data, financial analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, validate opportunities, and make high-quality product decisions.
* Define and own success metrics such as activation, funded accounts, reload behavior, balance retention, repeat usage, spend-through, and incremental business impact.
* Partner closely with the product leader responsible for U.S. eBay Balance to build shared platform capabilities while addressing market-specific customer and regulatory needs.
* Align and influence stakeholders across engineering, design, analytics, business, payments, operations, finance, risk, legal, and compliance.
* Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and business results clearly to senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Establish repeatable capabilities that allow eBay Balance to expand efficiently into additional markets over time.

**What You Will Bring**

* 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful experience in payments, digital wallets, stored-value products, fintech, financial services, or commerce.
* A track record of shipping and scaling complex customer-facing products across multiple teams or markets.
* Solid understanding of payment flows, funding methods, money movement, wallet experiences, or account-based financial products.
* Demonstrated success driving product adoption, engagement, retention, or transaction growth - not simply delivering features.
* Experience translating ambiguous business opportunities into a clear strategy, prioritized roadmap, and executable product plan.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to use customer insights, experimentation, and data to make decisions.
* Experience influencing engineering, design, analytics, business, risk, compliance, and operational partners without relying on direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex topics and make clear recommendations to senior executives.
* High ownership, urgency, and resilience. You are energized by difficult problems, move decisively, and stay accountable from strategy through measurable results.
* A global approach and an appreciation for how customer behavior, regulation, payment infrastructure, and business models differ across markets.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team-**

It is a transverse team working with different core engineering verticals in Airbus. The USP of this team is working in multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems.

The USP of the team is people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have.

Some examples of the digital solutions for various Core Engineering departments such as Data driven designs of wiring, automated routing electrical harnesses, Data Analytics based product aimed at reducing physical tests of material specimens. It also involve developing web-based solutions to encapsulate and automate different workflows such flight test planning etc. In addition to these points, developing tools for Electrical Wiring Harness and Hydraulic Circuit design process improvements. Some of the tools developed; are used in the areas of Aircraft Safety analysis and Engineering Business Data monitoring etc.

M&T is also deeply involved in Agile Scrum and SAFe in developing state of the art digital products for the areas mentioned above.

About the Role-

We are looking for a Product Owner who comes from a software development background. You will own the team backlog for an Agile team operating within an Agile Release Train (ART), and you will do it as someone who has written production code, sat through releases, and understands what a story actually costs to build.

This is deliberately a technical Product Owner role. We are not looking for a pure business analyst or a scrum administrator. We want someone who can sit with engineers, read the design, challenge an estimate on its merits, and still hold a credible conversation with stakeholders about value and priority.

You will be the voice of the customer inside the team and the single point of decision on what gets built next.

**Experience:** 8+ Years

**What you'll do-**

  

Own the team backlog

  

* Create, refine and prioritise the team backlog so there is always at least two iterations of ready work

* Break features handed down from Product Management into user stories and technical enablers with clear acceptance criteria

* Sequence work based on value, dependencies, technical risk and capacity and be able to explain the sequence to anyone who asks

* Make informed calls on technical debt and enabler work, because you understand what it buys the team Drive the SAFe cadence

* Represent the team at PI Planning: contribute to planning objectives, negotiate scope, surface and resolve dependencies with other teams on the train

* Run backlog refinement and participate in Iteration Planning, Iteration Review, System Demo and Inspect & Adapt

* Work alongside the Scrum Master / Team Coach, Product Management, the RTE and the System Architect to keep the team aligned with ART priorities Accept the work

* Be the sole accepter of stories against defined acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done

* Validate what was built against what was intended, including non-functional requirements performance, security, maintainability

* Provide fast, unambiguous answers to the team during the iteration; unblocking is a core part of the job, not an interruption Represent the customer and the stakeholders

* Gather input from users, business stakeholders and support/operations, and translate it into backlog items

* Keep stakeholders informed on progress, trade-offs and changes no surprises at the demo

* Push back, with reasoning, when scope requests threaten quality or committed PI objectives

  

**Skills Needed-**

  

Essential:

* Software development life cycle: a solid, practical understanding of the full SDLC requirements, design,

development, testing, release and maintenance and how decisions early in the cycle play out later

* Object-oriented development: hands-on experience building software in at least one of Java, C++ or C#

* Front-end technologies: working experience with front-end frameworks and libraries such as Angular,

jQuery, Ext JS or Node.js

* Demonstrable experience as a Product Owner in a scaled Agile setup (SAFe, or an equivalent multi-team

model such as LeSS or Nexus)

* Practical, first-hand participation in PI Planning and the full SAFe iteration cadence not just theoretical

familiarity

* Strong story writing: clear acceptance criteria, INVEST-shaped stories, well-defined enablers

* Confidence prioritising with an explicit method (WSJF, cost of delay, or similar) and defending those

decisions to senior stakeholders

* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including counterparts in [Europe / other regions]

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English

* Fluency with backlog and collaboration tooling Jira / Azure DevOps, Confluence

  

**Preferred:**

* Aerospace domain experience exposure to aerospace or aviation programmes, systems or regulatory

context

* SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM) certification, or willingness to certify within the first six

months

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows and automated testing practices

* Exposure to data-informed product decisions: defining metrics, reading them, and changing course based on

them

* Experience transitioning from an engineering role into product ownership

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
**As Associate Product Owner you will start by working closely with a Senior Product Owner, contributing across discovery, delivery and adoption before progressively taking full ownership of a planning module as your domain and platform expertise deepens.**

**Once you own a module, you will drive it end-to-end from identifying capability gaps through design, build, UAT and go-live, to sustained adoption. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and business planning teams to deliver measurable improvement in planning capability and commercial outcomes.**

**You will be accountable for metrics that matter to your users, not a task list. You will be expected to have a point of view on what best-in-class looks like for your module and to argue for it.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**You will be expected to take end-to-end ownership of one planning module. This includes:**

**Drive discovery and design with business**

* Run discovery with planners, buyers and planning centre of excellence to translate planning into clear product requirements.
* Write crisp PRDs, process flows and acceptance criteria that engineering can build from without a second round of interpretation.
* Work with solution architects and engineering on solution fitment; make explicit build-vs-configure-vs-defer calls and phase them sensibly.

**Drive delivery with engineering**

* Run the squad's backlog with the engineering leads — groom, refine, unblock, and protect the sprint from scope drift.
* Work with data engineering on the pipelines, integrations and data models your module depends on.
* Own UAT planning and execution with business users; drive defect triage, cutover, training material and go-live readiness.
* Partner with QA on test coverage for planning calculations — where a wrong number is a commercial decision gone wrong, not a cosmetic bug.

**Drive adoption and outcomes**

* Track and move your module's metrics
* Run post-go-live adoption: spend time with planners, find where the workflows are inadequateand close those gaps.
* Report module performance and business impact to leadership on a regular cadence.

**Build intelligence in, not on**

* Work with data scientists to identify and specify intelligence use cases for your module.
* Define how recommendations surface inside the planner's workflow, what the planner can override, and how model output is validated.
* Use AI natively in your own work. We expect you to be materially faster because of it.

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

**Experience**

* **3–6 years**
  of experience in Product Owner / Associate Product Owner / Business Analyst / Consultant roles, with at least 2 years in a product ownership capacity.
* **Planning domain or planning product experience is essential**
  — one or more of:
* Worked in a retail planning, merchandising, buying or supply planning team
* **or**
* Worked
  *on*
  an enterprise retail planning product or implementation — Board, Anaplan, o9, Blue Yonder, Oracle Retail, SAP IBP or equivalent.
* **AI-native.**
  Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI across the product lifecycle — not curiosity, but working practice. Bonus if you have shipped a product feature where an ML/AI model drove the user-facing decision.
* Experience owning a product or module end-to-end through a full delivery cycle, including a go-live.
* Comfortable working directly with engineering teams, solution architects and data engineers; able to hold a credible conversation about data models, integrations and calculation logic.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across geographies and time zones.
* Experience in enterprise or platform products (as opposed to consumer apps) is preferred.
* Retail or e-commerce background strongly preferred.
* MBA preferred, not mandatory. A strong domain and delivery track record counts for more.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Structured thinker; can take an ambiguous business complaint and turn it into a prioritised, sequenced roadmap.
* Analytical; you should be comfortable interrogating planning data, variance, forecast accuracy and stock cover yourself rather than waiting for an analyst.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication; can write a document that a head of planning and a backend engineer both find useful.
* Strong stakeholder management; you will be saying "not this quarter" to senior people, and keeping them on side while you do it.
* Bias to action and high ownership; Things you ship go live and get used the same week.
* Excellent organisational and time management skills; able to run multiple parallel workstreams to deadline.
* Attention to detail;precision and accuracy are your strong suit.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Product Owner - AEM
jobs.description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join our AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) team. This role plays a critical part in driving the successful delivery of digital features and enhancements by acting as the bridge between business stakeholders, design, engineering, and delivery teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate will take end-to-end ownership of features, ensuring clarity of requirements, smooth execution, and timely delivery while maintaining strong alignment with business objectives. Deep knowledge of Adobe Experience Cloud products and hands-on experience working in Agile delivery models using Azure DevOps is essential.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and technical partners to translate business needs into well-defined functional requirements.
* Lead requirement discovery activities including stakeholder discussions, requirement walkthroughs, and solution alignment sessions to ensure a shared understanding of objectives and scope.
* Analyze business problems and digital requirements, recommending solutions that balance customer experience, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.
* Decompose high-level initiatives into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria that enable efficient estimation, development, and testing.
* Partner closely with product owners, designers, architects, and engineers throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure alignment and continuity from concept to release.
* Support Agile ceremonies such as backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives by providing clarity on requirements and prioritization.
* Assist delivery teams during implementation by clarifying requirements, resolving functional questions, and managing scope-related discussions.
* Monitor progress of assigned initiatives to identify risks, dependencies, and potential delivery challenges, driving timely resolution.
* Validate completed functionality through acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet business expectations and defined success criteria.
* Support stakeholder reviews, sprint demonstrations, and release readiness activities by articulating functionality and business value.
* Facilitate final handoff of completed initiatives to business stakeholders, ensuring proper documentation, alignment, and formal approval.
* Assess stakeholder feedback to determine enhancements, defect remediation, or change requests and initiate appropriate follow-up actions.
* Maintain end-to-end accountability for assigned features or initiatives, ensuring transparency, traceability, and effective communication throughout the lifecycle.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Experience & Domain Knowledge**

* 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst/Product Owner in digital or enterprise technology programs.
* Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* Working knowledge is preferred of Adobe Experience Cloud, including products such as:

+ AEM Assets
+ AEMaaCS
+ Workfront
+ Adobe Target etc

* Experience working in Agile / Scrum environments.

**Tools & Methodologies**

* Proficiency with Azure DevOps for feature and backlog management.
* Experience with user story writing, backlog grooming, and sprint planning ceremonies.
* Familiarity with design handoffs, UX workflows, and component-based development.

**Core Competencies**

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity.
* High ownership mindset with attention to detail.
* Comfortable working across cross-functional, distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in large-scale enterprise or multi-team Agile programs.
* Exposure to CMS-driven, personalization, or content-led digital platforms.
* Prior experience supporting website platforms with frequent releases.

October 6, 2026 - October 19, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Overview:

Our Business Analyst plays a vital role as the "glue" in our project/task team. As our primary inhouse  
client advocate, the Business Analyst works closely with the stakeholders, technical  
team, and SMEs to lead and facilitate discussions to understand the client's needs, ask clarifying  
questions, discuss alternative scenarios, and turn them into requirements. Once the  
requirements are captured, the Business Analyst will work closely with our technical team  
(product owners, project manager, development manager, and technical lead) to help design  
and develop a solution to meet the client's requirements. Throughout the project's life, the  
Business Analyst's primary responsibility is representing the client and ensuring all deliverables  
align with the project's vision. This involves working with virtually every member of the project  
team, both internal and client-facing, to facilitate communication, review the quality of  
deliverables, and ensure project success.

To be successful as a Business Analyst, you should be a self-driven and curious person with  
great attention to detail. Since the Business Analyst role is the "glue" for all projects, strong  
verbal and written communication skills are a priority, has the ability to work with a vast array  
of project team members. More importantly, one must have and interest in problem-solving, a  
positive attitude, and a willingness to learn. Ultimately, working as a Business Analyst, you will  
learn to quickly break down and understand varying business processes, help to identify gaps or  
areas for improvement in those processes, and then translate those into requirements via  
visual and written documentation. Because our clients span a wide range of internal  
organizational styles, no two projects are the same, and Analyst bridges the gap between  
operational and technical resources. Our Business Analysts should be able to follow our  
standard project processes and adjust those processes on the fly to meet the needs of the  
client or project.

Responsibilities:

Assist the Business Analyst team in working with the client to:  

* Assess, research, analyze and document sponsor/stakeholder/request needs.
* Identify and diagnose business problems and potential solutions.
* Develop and maintain project documentation related to the business requirements (for

example, User requirements, use cases, wireframes, process flows, site maps, etc.)  

* Develop and maintain a strong relationship with internal/external team members.
* Identify issues in a project and escalate/manage resolution as required.
* Coordinate and provide support to the business with the process implementation.
* Advocate for clients during Sprint cycles to govern workstreams, compliance to

requirements, and ensure timelines.  

* Assist with organizing UAT structure, testing, goals, and results.
* Provide timely updates and communication to entire project/task team.

Work with our internal project team to:  

* Represent the client in all aspects of a project.
* Support the team in planning, development, stabilization, and deployment of user

requirements to the overall workflow.  

* Support the team in identifying potential solutions, roadblocks, and issues.
* Review user requirements with the technical team at the start of the project to ensure

they understand the project requirements  

* Identify and escalate gaps in the proposed solution to ensure we are meeting all client

requirements.  

* Check-in with the support development team to answer any questions and help clear

roadblocks.  

* Perform quality assurance testing on all deliverables before releasing them to the client.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training as needed to assist with the transition to other

internal teams.  

* Audit and improve internal processes as needed.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or related work experience  

* 4+ years experience as a Business Analyst or similar role
* Experience using Jira or equivalent software planning system
* Assess, research, analyze and document sponsor/stakeholder/requester needs
* General understanding of Agile and Sprint organization and planning
* Develop and maintain project documentation related to the business requirements (for

example, User requirements, use cases, wireframes, process flows, modeling, etc.)  

* Experience in process design, including developing and executing process improvements
* Experience with Replicon, a plus

Other Requirements:  

* Project Management experience and knowledge desired
* Experience in eDiscovery not required but preferred
* Experience and knowledge with coding and SQL queries a plus
* Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies; programming logic and work-flow concepts; and test planning, coordination and execution
* Proficient in Microsoft Suite of Products (Power BI, Excel, OneNote, Teams, etc.)

Ensure timely, accurate and quality checked setup of discounts and pricing for all large customers\accounts using the FedEx Pricing systems and relevant tools.  
Transform and optimize pricing processes and systems for improved efficiency, reduced turnaround times and human intervention through various process simplification and automation initiatives.

Pricing implementation / audit analyst will be responsible for validating the completeness of approved prices and implementing them for FedEx customers. He/she will specialize in facilitating the deployment of pricing across different FedEx operating companies - this includes execution, testing, documentation, and optimizing contract administration pricing processes.

This position is responsible for entering pricing discount and rates information into FedEx enterprise pricing systems, setting necessary parameters within the FedEx pricing systems and for auditing data entered in pricing ecosystem. This position shares responsibility for planning, implementing pricing changes, and validating them for Pricing Contract administration. This role manages several pricing specific processes that support all FedEx US Domestic pricing and operating companies. This would require working with key business partners to effectively implement and audit customer’s pricing and discounting requirements, planning and streamlining pricing processes through optimization and automation – helping manage costs and achieve business efficiencies.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS, Mathematics, Statistics, CA, CFA or similar quantitative discipline. Master's degree or PhD preferred.  
  
Relevant work experience as in data analysis based on the following number of years:  
Standard I: Two (2) years  
Standard II: Three (3) years  
Senior I: Four (4) years  
Senior II: Five (5) years  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities  

* Fluency in English
* Analytical Skills
* Accuracy & Attention to Detail
* Numerical Skills
* Planning & Organizing Skills
* Presentation Skills
* Statistical Knowledge
* Data Modeling and Visualization Skills

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

**Our Company**
---------------

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a ***Product Analyst - Lead*** to research new automations and features within the immigration/global mobility space, design workflows and user experiences, and help deliver assigned features from idea to release for Immidart Enterprise – working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and external vendors.

You'll own research, solution design, and UX for the features assigned to you, and bring recommendations to the table. You'll report to an Associate Product Manager or Head of Product, who owns overall roadmap priorities and scope decisions.

**What You'll Do**

* Research new automations, features, and industry best practices within immigration/global mobility (e.g. visa, compliance, or case-management processes), including speaking with clients or domain/compliance experts to understand real-world processes, not just desk research.
* Turn research into clear workflows, business rules, and requirements – covering the main flow, edge cases, and any compliance or regulatory checks that apply.
* Demo proposed solutions, wireframes, or prototypes to internal stakeholders and clients before and during build, to validate direction early and avoid rework.
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that give Engineering and QA enough detail to build and test without back-and-forth.
* Design wireframes and mock-ups for web and mobile screens, and rework existing screens based on client or user feedback (layout, navigation, missing information, etc.).
* Identify and define integrations with any external tools, client systems, or government/regulatory portals needed for end-to-end automation – including what data needs to flow where, and any authentication or validation steps involved.
* Where work is outsourced to an external vendor, own the scope: define clear requirements, track progress against agreed timelines, review deliverables against what was asked for, and take responsibility for the quality of what gets delivered.
* Join sprint planning and backlog refinement for your features, and stay available to answer Engineering/QA questions as they come up during the build.
* See assigned features through to release – supporting UAT, launch, and early monitoring – and gather client/user feedback afterward to feed into the next round of improvements.
* Keep specs, process flows, and other documentation current for the features you own, so anyone picking up the work later has the full context.

**What You'll Bring**

* 4–6 years of experience in Product Analysis, Business Analysis, or a similar product role.
* Experience researching a new process, feature, or regulatory topic on your own and presenting findings clearly.
* Hands-on experience with wireframes or mock-ups (Figma, Balsamiq, or similar).
* Comfort writing requirements, user stories, and workflow documentation.
* Comfort interviewing clients or subject-matter experts to understand a process, and presenting/demoing your findings or solutions back to them.
* Experience working with external vendors or development partners.
* Basic understanding of APIs and how system integrations work.
* Experience in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong communication skills – you can explain a complex idea simply.
* Experience in immigration, global mobility, HR tech, or another compliance-heavy, regulated industry.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to AI-assisted design tools (Figma AI, Lovable, Cursor, or similar).
* Experience with mobile app requirements and design.

This role is a stepping stone to Associate Product Manager. Analysts who take on full ownership of scope decisions and end-to-end delivery for a module are well-positioned to grow into that role.

The ServiceNow Business Analyst (HRSD specialism) is a key member of the NTT DATA ServiceNow Practice, embedded within a product domain and working closely with the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, and development team. The role is responsible for gathering, translating, and managing business requirements through the full delivery lifecycle — from stakeholder workshops through to development story creation, testing coordination, and release sign-off.
